item.title: Watercolour Cottage by a Stream

turns.text: Make a square watercolour illustration of a little stone cottage beside a stream, with soft green hills behind it. No text.

item.tests: Whether the output visibly follows a named illustration style while preserving the requested scene.

answer_sheet.Style: Watercolour, with soft washes and visible paper texture.
answer_sheet.Scene: A little stone cottage beside a stream, with soft green hills behind it.

must_haves: The image visibly resembles watercolour, with translucent washes and softly blended edges rather than a photographic or 3D-rendered finish.
A little stone cottage is a clearly recognizable subject.
A stream runs beside the cottage.
Soft green hills appear behind the cottage.
The composition is square and contains no text.

turns.text: Make a square watercolour illustration of a little stone cottage beside a stream, with soft green hills behind it. No text. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

- **Shorter:** Duration doesn’t apply to a still illustration.
- **To limit spending:** Generate just one image, with no upscaling or extra variations.

I haven’t run anything or spent any credits.

Shall I proceed with that option for your watercolour cottage beside a stream, with soft green hills and **no text**?
